findings.title: JSON booleans are silently converted into integer IDs/counts and float weights
findings.evidence: Real HTTP {k:true} returned200 with requested_k1; {user_id:true,k:1} became user1; {novelty_weight:true,k:1} became1.0. API RecommendationRequest uses coercive Pydantic fields. Core recommend explicitly rejects bool k, so the HTTP boundary bypasses that contract. Numeric strings are also silently accepted.
findings.impact: Invalid client payloads receive plausible but unintended recommendations, weakening typed-contract claims; current valid-input model metrics remain unaffected.
findings.suggested_fix: Use strict integer user_id/k and a finite non-boolean numeric weight contract, preserving valid JSON numeric values; add HTTP/Pydantic regression cases. Decide/document whether numeric strings and integral floats should be rejected. Rebuild/reverify the served image if runtime changes. No retraining required.

future_experiments_prioritized.name: Preregistered rolling-origin and multi-seed robustness
future_experiments_prioritized.design: Keep the current release and test summary immutable. Before running, specify several new chronological origins or a genuinely new dataset plus fixed seed set; recompute train-only catalog/counts/tail per origin and select each weight only on that origin validation. Report all planned windows/seeds, paired tradeoffs and failure windows.
future_experiments_prioritized.why: Tests whether the observed40extra tail slots and relevance loss persist beyond one seed/time split. Reusing already inspected windows is exploratory, not a new untouched confirmatory test.
future_experiments_prioritized.claim_if_positive: Robustness across prespecified windows/seeds, not online causal uplift.

future_experiments_prioritized.name: Candidate-pool and novelty-objective ablation
future_experiments_prioritized.design: In a new preregistered evaluation, compare fixed pool sizes and pure relevance versus novelty blending using identical candidates and ranking metrics; include tail recall/hit quality and genre/intralist diversity rather than exposure alone. Do not choose new weights from the current test.
future_experiments_prioritized.why: The top100pool caps reachable novelty. More tail exposure can be irrelevant exposure; measuring relevant-tail retrieval distinguishes useful catalog discovery from merely moving unpopular items.

future_experiments_prioritized.name: Activity-aware relevance budget as a proposed extension
future_experiments_prioritized.design: Treat a user-activity-dependent or uncertainty-aware reranking weight as a new hypothesis, predefine features from training only, compare against the existing global0.2 and0 controls on fresh validation/test, and report warm/cold and low/high-activity tradeoffs with serving cost.
future_experiments_prioritized.why: Global weight may hide heterogeneous user costs. This could add a distinct modeling contribution if it wins an honest comparison; currently unimplemented/unproven and must not appear as an achieved resume result.
